_comment: THE TOLERANCE POLICY. Five classes, and a case names exactly one of them.
A CASE WITHOUT A tolerance_class IS AN ERROR, NEVER A FALLBACK. A default
tolerance is a number nobody chose, applied to a comparison nobody reviewed:
it turns a closed-form statistic and an optimiser-driven estimate into the
same claim. The harness refuses the case instead.
THIS FILE IS NOT AN ARTIFACT. It carries no sidecar and artifacts.sidecars
stays 7. It lives beside the cases it governs because it is authored by hand
and reviewed as prose, not generated from the corpus and sealed.
WHAT MAKES A CLASS LOAD-BEARING RATHER THAN DECORATIVE. The harness perturbs
every numeric leaf of a case's `expected` by ten times the class's rtol (or
by ten times its atol where rtol is zero, or by one representable step where
both are zero) and requires the comparison to REFUSE the perturbed payload.
A case whose numbers are so small that the class's atol swallows that
perturbation is rejected when it is loaded, not when it is run. Without that
control this file would be a document nobody can fail.
WHY pvalue-1e-3 CARRIES THE LARGEST atol OF THE THREE NUMERIC CLASSES. A
p-value is reported to three decimals in most published tables and is
compared near zero, where a relative tolerance means nothing: 1e-3 relative
to 1e-12 is 1e-15. The absolute floor is what does the work there, and it is
set at 1e-6 so that two p-values a published table cannot distinguish are not
held apart by the harness.
simulation-seeded IS exact WITH A PRECONDITION. A seeded draw is reproducible
to the bit or it is not seeded, so the tolerance is zero. The precondition is
checked by the harness and NOT stated here: the case must carry `seed` in its
inputs and the node must declare a `seed` argument in node-specs.json. A case
that claims this class without both is an error, not a skip.
THE UNSEEDED STOCHASTIC SET IS NOT IN THIS FILE, DELIBERATELY. It lives in
artifacts/node-specs.json under vocabulary.stochastic_unseeded_fns and the
harness reads it from there. A copy here would be a second list free to drift
from the contract, and the drift would be silent: the copy would keep
answering after the vocabulary moved.

exact.for: a value that is transported rather than computed, or a closed form with no rounding step

statistic-1e-6.for: a closed-form test statistic, where the only error is floating-point summation order

estimate-1e-4.for: an optimiser-driven estimate, where the convergence criterion sets the floor

pvalue-1e-3.for: a p-value, compared near zero where the absolute floor dominates

simulation-seeded.for: a seeded draw, reproducible to the bit; the harness requires the seed in the inputs and in the node's declared arguments
